description: This PHP file defines a migration class for version 5.4.0 of the OrangeHRM system. It performs database schema updates, inserts configuration values, modifies language strings, adds new modules, and creates OAuth2 related tables, managing the upgrade process for that specific system version.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A migration class that updates the database schema, configurations, and language strings for version 5.4.0 of OrangeHRM.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs the database schema updates, inserts, and configuration modifications for the migration.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string of this migration, '5.4.0'.

methods.name: updateLangStringVersion
methods.description: Updates the language string version in the database to match the migration version.

methods.name: getLangStringHelper
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the LangStringHelper instance.

methods.name: modifyDefaultRequiredPasswordStrength
methods.description: Adjusts the default required password strength config value based on existing settings.

methods.name: modifyDefaultPasswordEnforcement
methods.description: Adjusts the password enforcement configuration value.

methods.name: createOAuth2Tables
methods.description: Creates OAuth2 related tables and inserts default OAuth2 client data, also sets encryption keys and TTL values.

methods.name: changePermissionForAttendanceConfigurationAPI
methods.description: Sets permissions for the attendance configuration API data group.

methods.name: changePermissionForTimeConfigPeriodAPI
methods.description: Sets permissions for the time sheet configuration API data group.

methods.name: changePermissionForEmployeeWorkShiftAPI
methods.description: Sets permissions for the employee work shift API data group.
